# Renegade Burrito

> Colorado-based, family-owned fast-casual Mexican restaurant brand founded in Westminster, Colorado in 2017. Breakfast burritos served all day, signature burritos, street tacos, bowls and catering at six metro Denver restaurants.

## Official ordering
Online ordering, delivery, Burrito Bucks rewards and digital gift cards are available through renegadeburrito.com and the official Renegade Burrito apps. Official apps: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/renegade-burrito/id1512879875 and https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.toasttab.renegadeburrito

## Menu categories
Breakfast burritos (all day), signature Customer Favorite burritos, build-your-own burritos/bowls/tacos/quesadillas/salads, street tacos, nachos and sides, kids meals, drinks, desserts. Prices vary by location.

## Catering
Box lunches (min 10), burrito and street taco catering bars (20+), Renegade 12 Pack, chips and dips. Groups of 10–1,000 across metro Denver and the Front Range. https://www.renegadeburrito.com/catering
